sentences.text: This suit is filed by the pontiff of Sri.Ramalingeshwara Mutt, 6 th Block, Rajajinagar, against Western Railway and another.
Initially, the plaintiff has filed suit for injunction simplicitor.
2. It is the case of the plaintiff that the Mutt is established in the year 15th Century with endowment made by the King of Keladi.
The Sri.Ramalingeshwara Mutt is headed by Matadhipathi.
There are long lines of heads of Mutt at different points of time, there were some dispute about who is the head of the Mutt.
But, all the issues have been resolved by active participation of Government of Karnataka.
Presently, the plaintiff is adorned as Sri. Chandramouleshwara Shivacharya Swamiji as head of Mutt.
According to the plaintiff, during the regime of the Keladi Kings, they were granted several acres of lands in and around Keladi, Bengaluru.
One of such property is Sy.No.18, Corporation No.13/2, 6th Cross, Gandhinagar, Bengaluru.
This property was gifted by Gurusiddaswamy of Thippasetty Math in favour of plaintiff's Mutt for the purpose of construction of shed of buffaloes.
The Gift Deed dated 9-9-1929 evidencing the fact that the Gift is acted upon and possession of the suit property was transferred to plaintiff - Mutt.
The BBMP, the then Bengaluru City Corporation issued notification on 1-9-1997 to declare the vacant property along with other vacant properties of Bengaluru City to take over to the Corporation.
The owners of the property including the plaintiff - Mutt filed objections to the said notification.

One K.M.Shivarudraswamy on behalf of plaintiff - Mutt has filed O.S.No.1923/1975, seeking permanent injunction against the Corporation, the City Civil Court has decreed the suit in favour of the plaintiff - Mutt.

The defendant No.1 - Railway Authority without having any document regarding the title, the Department of Railway trespassed into the suit schedule property, digging the ground for construction of the building.
The act of the defendant was resisted by the Mutt.
In spite of resistance, the defendant on 21-03-2018, came with men and machines and started to dig the foundation in the suit schedule property.
The plaintiff stated that there is threat of dispossession by the first defendant, hence, he prays to decree the suit.
3. The defendant is South Western Railway Department, it appeared and filed written statement specifically denying the ownership and possession of the plaintiff - Mutt and the Department of Railway

The acquisition proceedings were completed prior to 1-9-1900 by the Mysore Government and ,the Department of Railways paid compensation to the land owners.
The land was handed over to railways, but the records are maintained by the Revenue Department.
The defendant No.1 contended that in the year 1948, entire 600 acres handed over to Railway Department by publishing the Gazette Notification in Mysore Retrocede Act and Gazette dated 5-8-1948.
The possession of entire land was taken by the Railway Department.
The Officers Quarters handed over to Bengaluru City Railway station and land at Sheshadri Road.
From the date of acquisition, the Railway Department is in possession and enjoyment of the suit property.
The vacant land also in possession of Railway Department.

For all these reasons, I answer issue Nos.1 and 2 in the negative.
25. Issue No.3:-
The defendant - Railway Department has categorically denied the ownership and possession of the plaintiff or Ramalingeshwara Mutt over the suit property.
They have claimed their ownership and possession over the suit property.
They have produced the documents in support of their case.

Under these circumstances, there is a clear denial of title of the plaintiff, in view of the Judgment of Hon'ble Supreme Court in Anathula Sudhakar Vs. P.Buchi Reddy (Dead) by L.Rs,
reported in AIR 2008 SC 2033

sentences.text: The plaintiff required to file comprehensive suit for declaration of his title, recovery of possession and other consequential relief by impleading of the interested person as parties.
In this case, the Corporation Girls High School has not made as party.
The injunction is sought with reference to whole property.
Therefore, the suit in present form without seeking the declaration of title and possession is not maintainable.
Hence, I answer issue No.3 in the Negative.
26. Issue No.4:- The plaintiff failed to prove the lawful possession of the suit property as on the date of filing of the suit and also failed to prove the alleged interference by the defendant.
Hence, he is not entitled for any reliefs claimed by the plaintiff.
Accordingly, I answer issue No.4 in the negative.

27. Issue No.5:- For the foregoing reasons, I pass the following:-
ORDER Suit of the plaintiff dismissed with costs.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The Gift Deed dated 9-9-1929 evidencing the fact that the Gift is acted upon and possession of the suit property was transferred to plaintiff - Mutt.
The BBMP, the then Bengaluru City Corporation issued notification on 1-9-1997 to declare the vacant property along with other vacant properties of Bengaluru City to take over to the Corporation.
The owners of the property including the plaintiff - Mutt filed objections to the said notification.
The defendant No.1 - Railway Authority without having any document regarding the title, the Department of Railway trespassed into the suit schedule property, digging the ground for construction of the building.
The act of the defendant was resisted by the Mutt.
The possession of entire land was taken by the Railway Department.
Therefore, the Railway Department also not handed over the possession of vacant land which is used as playground i.e., the suit property.
The first defendant specifically contended that suit filed by the plaintiff without having any title is not maintainable.
Even the Corporation has also not made as party and therefore, the suit is bad for non-joinder of necessary parties.
The defendant No.1 contended that one Ramachandra Swamy has filed O.S.No.4386/2015 before CCH-2 for injunction.
In the said suit, he filed application for grant of exparte temporary injunction.
The application came to be dismissed on 5-9-2015.
Ramachandra Swamy has filed MFA No.7544/2015 before the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka, it was pending at the time of filing of the written statement.
In the said suit, the present plaintiff filed I.A. No.1 under Order 1 Rule 10 of CPC to implead him as plaintiff in O.S.No.4386/2015, the application came to be dismissed.
The plaintiff in O.S.No.4386/2015 filed one more application for amendment of the plaint, it was pending at the time of filing the written statement.
The defendant contended that another one Swamiji Neelakanta Saranga Desikendra Mahaswamigalu Ramalingeshwara Mutt filed Revision Petition before Joint Director of Land Records, Bengaluru City Survey, South Zone in CTS(B) Revision No.10/17-18 against the ADLR and Enquiry Officer, Commissioner, BBMP and Defendant Railway Department.
It was also pending at the time of filing the written statement.
The plaintiff has no right, title or interest over the suit property has filed a false suit against the defendant.
Therefore, the suit filed by the plaintiff is not maintainable.
opennyai_summary.issue:
4. Based on the pleadings, My predecessor in office has framed the following:-
1 Whether the plaintiff proves its possession over suit property as on the date of suit?
2. Whether plaintiff proves the actual interference caused by the defendant?
3. Whether the suit of the plaintiff is maintainable in view of specific denial of title of plaintiff over suit property by the defendant?
4. Whether the plaintiff is entitled for Permanent Injunction as claimed in the plaint?
What Order or Decree?
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
When there is a Management Committee, though he is regime head of the Mutt but management lies with the Management Committee.
Since the P.W.1 stated that the resolution was passed by Mutt Management Committee to file the suit, the production of resolution is necessary to validate the institution of the suit by the plaintiff.
Because, as per the revenue records produced by the plaintiff, it is agricultural land.
If really, it is agricultural land, there must be RTCs standing in the name of the plaintiff - Mutt.
16.
The plaintiff produced incomplete document and the plaintiff is guilty of suppressing the material fact that subsequently, the exparte Judgment passed in O.S.No.1923/1975 was set aside and the suit is renumbered as O.S.No.5300/1990.
The entire cross-examination of the present plaintiff in LAC No.51/2014 is sufficient to hold that the plaintiff is not at all head of Mutt, not appointed by previous Swamiji or any Management Committee.
They have claimed their ownership and possession over the suit property.
Under these circumstances, there is a clear denial of title of the plaintiff, in view of the Judgment of Hon'ble Supreme Court in Anathula Sudhakar Vs. P.Buchi Reddy (Dead) by L.Rs,
reported in AIR 2008 SC 2033
The plaintiff required to file comprehensive suit for declaration of his title, recovery of possession and other consequential relief by impleading of the interested person as parties.
In this case, the Corporation Girls High School has not made as party.
The injunction is sought with reference to whole property.
Therefore, the suit in present form without seeking the declaration of title and possession is not maintainable.
26. Issue No.4:- The plaintiff failed to prove the lawful possession of the suit property as on the date of filing of the suit and also failed to prove the alleged interference by the defendant.

Hence, he is not entitled for any reliefs claimed by the plaintiff.
27. Issue No.5:- For the foregoing reasons, I pass the following:-
ORDER Suit of the plaintiff dismissed with costs.
